title: Multiple confirmation dialogs on clise
author: zgabi
body_snippet: I have 2 open connections. I clise mRemoteNG, it shows a "Do you want to close all connections" confirmation window: I click yes, then shows another confirmation: Do you want to close panel "general"? When I accept the close all, no o...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
@zgabi Good catch — this is a UX issue. When you close the app with multiple connections:

1. First dialog: "Do you want to close all connections?" (from `FrmMain.FormClosing`)
2. Second dialog: "Do you want to close panel General?" (from `ConnectionWindow.FormClosing`)

If you already confirmed #1, dialog #2 is redundant. We'll fix this by skipping the per-panel confirmation when the user already confirmed the app-level "close all" dialog. Will be addressed in a future update.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Fixed in `f67ee54bd`. The root cause: `IsClosing` flag was set **after** the `window.Close()` loop in `FrmMain_FormClosing()`. When each `ConnectionWindow.Connection_FormClosing()` checked `!FrmMain.Default.IsClosing`, it was still `false`, so it showed the second "close panel" dialog.

Fix: moved `IsClosing = true` before the window close loop (resets to `false` if close is cancelled).

Now only one confirmation dialog appears on exit. Will be in the next nightly.
